meta.title: MIA
meta.description: How could they go missing? They were just here.

units.rawText: Honestly, why am I here now and not stuck back in Engineering?
units.displayText: Honestly, why am I here now and not stuck back in Engineering?

spans.text: Honestly, why am I here now and not stuck back in Engineering?

units.rawText: My model's only half-built and I haven't finished watching my series yet... This is annoying, I kind of wish I were home.
units.displayText: My model's only half-built and I haven't finished watching my series yet... This is annoying, I kind of wish I were home.

units.rawText: Croque attaches a mechanical device to the data port of the firewall. It contains a decryption program written by Antonina.
units.displayText: Croque attaches a mechanical device to the data port of the firewall. It contains a decryption program written by Antonina.

spans.text: Croque attaches a mechanical device to the data port of the firewall. It contains a decryption program written by Antonina.

units.rawText: Persicaria always used to nag me about how I never did any fieldwork, to say nothing of doing scouting runs.
units.displayText: Persicaria always used to nag me about how I never did any fieldwork, to say nothing of doing scouting runs.

spans.text: Persicaria always used to nag me about how I never did any fieldwork, to say nothing of doing scouting runs.

units.rawText: And now I actively volunteered to do something like this. I must have been out of my mind or something. Eh, better not complain, I chose this, after all.
units.displayText: And now I actively volunteered to do something like this. I must have been out of my mind or something. Eh, better not complain, I chose this, after all.

spans.text: And now I actively volunteered to do something like this. I must have been out of my mind or something. Eh, better not complain, I chose this, after all.

units.rawText: Croque, oh Croque, you can't forget the decisions from your past. And besides, isn't there something good waiting for you?
units.displayText: Croque, oh Croque, you can't forget the decisions from your past. And besides, isn't there something good waiting for you?

spans.text: Croque, oh Croque, you can't forget the decisions from your past. And besides, isn't there something good waiting for you?

units.rawText: Inside the Oasis Headquarters.
units.displayText: Inside the Oasis Headquarters.

spans.text: Inside the Oasis Headquarters.

units.rawText: Here's your coffee. You ought to get some rest, Professor.
units.displayText: Here's your coffee. You ought to get some rest, Professor.

spans.text: Here's your coffee. You ought to get some rest, Professor.

units.rawText: Thank you. Give me a quick summary of the recent work we've done.
units.displayText: Thank you. Give me a quick summary of the recent work we've done.

spans.text: Thank you. Give me a quick summary of the recent work we've done.

units.rawText: Everything's gone very well. While there are still many problems which need to be dealt with, on the whole the Oasis has found its feet.
units.displayText: Everything's gone very well. While there are still many problems which need to be dealt with, on the whole the Oasis has found its feet.

spans.text: Everything's gone very well. While there are still many problems which need to be dealt with, on the whole the Oasis has found its feet.

units.rawText: In addition, our friction with the outside world has been decreasing, and it's been a long time since our defensive forces last encountered Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: In addition, our friction with the outside world has been decreasing, and it's been a long time since our defensive forces last encountered Sanctifiers.

spans.text: In addition, our friction with the outside world has been decreasing, and it's been a long time since our defensive forces last encountered Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: In fact, we can even afford the luxury to send people to other sectors to perform operand collections, neural cloud rescues and other missions.
units.displayText: In fact, we can even afford the luxury to send people to other sectors to perform operand collections, neural cloud rescues and other missions.

spans.text: In fact, we can even afford the luxury to send people to other sectors to perform operand collections, neural cloud rescues and other missions.

units.rawText: How about Antonina and the others? They haven't looked well ever since they came back from Cyclopes.
units.displayText: How about Antonina and the others? They haven't looked well ever since they came back from Cyclopes.

spans.text: How about Antonina and the others? They haven't looked well ever since they came back from Cyclopes.

units.rawText: Antonina... She still spends all day cooped up in her workroom. And after learning about everything, Sol voluntarily upped the intensity of her training program.
units.displayText: Antonina... She still spends all day cooped up in her workroom. And after learning about everything, Sol voluntarily upped the intensity of her training program.

spans.text: Antonina... She still spends all day cooped up in her workroom. And after learning about everything, Sol voluntarily upped the intensity of her training program.

units.rawText: Then there's Croque. Did you know? She actively volunteered to take part in the sector scouting missions.
units.displayText: Then there's Croque. Did you know? She actively volunteered to take part in the sector scouting missions.

spans.text: Then there's Croque. Did you know? She actively volunteered to take part in the sector scouting missions.

units.rawText: Croque? Volunteer? Are my ears deceiving me?
units.displayText: Croque? Volunteer? Are my ears deceiving me?

spans.text: Croque? Volunteer? Are my ears deceiving me?

units.rawText: I had the same reaction as you back then.
units.displayText: I had the same reaction as you back then.

spans.text: I had the same reaction as you back then.

units.rawText: Still, I think you won't be surprised once you know the name of the sector which Croque went to.
units.displayText: Still, I think you won't be surprised once you know the name of the sector which Croque went to.

spans.text: Still, I think you won't be surprised once you know the name of the sector which Croque went to.

units.rawText: It's called Helios, a renowned industrial sector under Svarog. You know Croque's always liked that sort of thing.
units.displayText: It's called Helios, a renowned industrial sector under Svarog. You know Croque's always liked that sort of thing.

, a renowned industrial sector under Svarog. You know Croque's always liked that sort of thing.

units.rawText: Ah, so it's like a junket, then...
units.displayText: Ah, so it's like a junket, then...

spans.text: Ah, so it's like a junket, then...

units.rawText: Hehe, well, now that you put it that way it DOES sound like that...
units.displayText: Hehe, well, now that you put it that way it DOES sound like that...

spans.text: Hehe, well, now that you put it that way it DOES sound like that...

units.rawText: Still, I think this is pretty good. Croque's too much of a shut-in most of the time, heading outside would do her some good.

spans.text: How does it feel to be carrying out a scouting mission on your own?

units.rawText: ...I'm missing my cola and air conditioning already.

units.rawText: All that stuff about being a renowned industrial sector was all a lie. I didn't even manage to see the Arche Pyr. Just my luck I guess.

units.displayText: Eh, Professor? How come you're here too...

spans.text: Eh, Professor? How come you're here too...

units.rawText: Ahem, just to make things clear, while I don't deny that there might have been just a bit of personal motivation involved in signing up for this mission, I can still tell what's important!
